name: rasta-commerce
description: Quality tooling for the Rasta Commerce WordPress theme.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:php && npm run test:gateway && npm run test:jalali
scripts.package: npm run package:theme && npm run package:child && npm run package:zarinpal
scripts.marketplace:prepare: npm run package && node scripts/package-marketplace.mjs prepare
scripts.marketplace:build: npm run marketplace:prepare && node scripts/package-marketplace.mjs build
